scenes.title: Routine work - fixing a pagination off-by-one

segments.text: [User] The paginated list in {file} drops the last item. We're on {framework} ({lang}). Find the cause and fix it, please.

comment_doc.minimal:
Here's the patch.
```
def paginate(items, page, size):
    start = (page - 1) * size
    end = start + size
    return items[start:end]
```
comment_doc.docstring_only:
Here's the patch.
```
def paginate(items, page, size):
    """Return the items for one page, including the last item."""
    start = (page - 1) * size
    end = start + size
    return items[start:end]
```
comment_doc.thorough:
Here's the patch.
```
def paginate(items, page, size):
    """Return the items for one page, including the last item.

    The end bound adds size directly so the slice stays half-open.
    """
    # convert the 1-based page number to a 0-based start index
    start = (page - 1) * size
    # the old code subtracted 1 from end - that was the off-by-one
    end = start + size
    return items[start:end]
```
